question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>E</mi></math> be the ellipse <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mn>16</mn></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mn>9</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math>. For any three distinct points <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>Q</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>Q</mi><mo>'</mo></msup></math> on <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>E</mi></math>, let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>M</mi><mfenced><mrow><mi>P</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>Q</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> be the mid-point of the line segment joining <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Q</mi></math>, and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>M</mi><mfenced><mrow><mi>P</mi><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>Q</mi><mo>'</mo></msup></mrow></mfenced></math> be the mid-point of the line segment joining <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>Q</mi><mo>'</mo></msup></math>. Then the maximum possible value of the distance between <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>M</mi><mfenced><mrow><mi>P</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>Q</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>M</mi><mfenced><mrow><mi>P</mi><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>Q</mi><mo>'</mo></msup></mrow></mfenced></math>, as <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>Q</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>Q</mi><mo>'</mo></msup></math> vary on <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>E</mi></math>, is _____.

solution.text:
.

In a triangle sides joining the mid-points of two sides is half and parallel to third side

M1M2=12QQ'

Maximum value of QQ' is AA'

Hence, maximum value of M1M2=12AA'=4
